description: Abbreviated legal-entity forms. Used by the regex ORG rule, as bare-legal-form stoplist entries in NER, and to keep these abbreviations uppercase during NER case normalization. Longer abbreviations are listed before shorter ones sharing a tail. Collision-prone abbreviations (ПК — also 'персональный компьютер', ГК — also 'Гражданский кодекс') are deliberately omitted. To extend: add another legal-form abbreviation; keep its full spelling in dict_org_forms.json.
